name: 0000_groovy_quicksilver
statements:
CREATE TABLE `channels` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`workspace_id` text NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`topic` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`kind` text DEFAULT 'text' NOT NULL,
	`position` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);

CREATE TABLE `huddles` (
	`channel_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`room_name` text NOT NULL,
	`url` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`channel_id`) REFERENCES `channels`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);

CREATE TABLE `memberships` (
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`workspace_id` text NOT NULL,
	`role` text NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`user_id`, `workspace_id`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);

CREATE TABLE `messages` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`channel_id` text NOT NULL,
	`author_id` text NOT NULL,
	`text` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`channel_id`) REFERENCES `channels`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`author_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE INDEX `messages_channel_time` ON `messages` (`channel_id`,`created_at`);

CREATE TABLE `reactions` (
	`message_id` text NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`emoji` text NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`message_id`, `user_id`, `emoji`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`message_id`) REFERENCES `messages`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);

CREATE TABLE `users` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`password_hash` text NOT NULL,
	`color` text NOT NULL,
	`role` text DEFAULT 'member' NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `users_name_unique` ON `users` (`name`);

name: 0001_young_titania
statements:
CREATE TABLE `huddle_participants` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`channel_id` text NOT NULL,
	`meeting_id` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`channel_id`) REFERENCES `channels`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
ALTER TABLE `messages` ADD `edited_at` integer;

name: 0002_first_nova
statements:
CREATE TABLE `auth_account` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`account_id` text NOT NULL,
	`provider_id` text NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`access_token` text,
	`refresh_token` text,
	`id_token` text,
	`access_token_expires_at` integer,
	`refresh_token_expires_at` integer,
	`scope` text,
	`password` text,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `auth_user`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);
CREATE INDEX `auth_account_user` ON `auth_account` (`user_id`);

CREATE TABLE `auth_session` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`token` text NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`ip_address` text,
	`user_agent` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `auth_user`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `auth_session_token_unique` ON `auth_session` (`token`);
CREATE INDEX `auth_session_user` ON `auth_session` (`user_id`);

CREATE TABLE `auth_user` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`email` text NOT NULL,
	`email_verified` integer DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	`image` text,
	`username` text,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `auth_user_email_unique` ON `auth_user` (`email`);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `auth_user_username_unique` ON `auth_user` (`username`);

CREATE TABLE `auth_verification` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`identifier` text NOT NULL,
	`value` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX `auth_verification_identifier` ON `auth_verification` (`identifier`);

name: 0003_foamy_molly_hayes
statements:
CREATE TABLE `threads` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`channel_id` text NOT NULL,
	`parent_message_id` text,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`author_id` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`channel_id`) REFERENCES `channels`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`parent_message_id`) REFERENCES `messages`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null,
	FOREIGN KEY (`author_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `threads_parent_message_id_unique` ON `threads` (`parent_message_id`);
CREATE INDEX `threads_channel_time` ON `threads` (`channel_id`,`created_at`);
ALTER TABLE `messages` ADD `reply_to_id` text;
ALTER TABLE `messages` ADD `thread_id` text REFERENCES threads(id) ON DELETE cascade;
CREATE INDEX `messages_thread_time` ON `messages` (`thread_id`,`created_at`);

name: 0004_military_surge
statements:
CREATE TABLE `attachments` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`channel_id` text NOT NULL,
	`owner_id` text NOT NULL,
	`message_id` text,
	`storage_id` text NOT NULL,
	`object_key` text NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`size` integer NOT NULL,
	`content_type` text DEFAULT 'application/octet-stream' NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`channel_id`) REFERENCES `channels`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`owner_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`message_id`) REFERENCES `messages`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null,
	FOREIGN KEY (`storage_id`) REFERENCES `storage_configs`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE INDEX `attachments_message` ON `attachments` (`message_id`);
CREATE INDEX `attachments_pending` ON `attachments` (`created_at`);

CREATE TABLE `live_tickets` (
	`hash` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`authorization` text NOT NULL,
	`origin` text NOT NULL,
	`workspace_id` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` integer NOT NULL
);

name: 0005_anycord_brand
statements:
-- Only application-owned branding changes. Human profiles and messages are untouched.
UPDATE users SET name = 'Anycord' WHERE id = 'system' AND role = 'bot' AND name = 'Cellcord' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE name = 'Anycord' AND id <> 'system');

UPDATE messages SET text = 'Welcome to your server. This is the beginning of #general. Say hello, share a file, or start a thread to keep the conversation going.' WHERE id = 'welcome' AND author_id = 'system' AND text = 'Welcome to your server. This is the beginning of #general. Invite someone on this machine to create an account, or open a second session to try realtime chat.';

name: 0006_cynical_jetstream
statements:
CREATE TABLE `invitations` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`hash` text NOT NULL,
	`workspace_id` text NOT NULL,
	`created_by` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`max_uses` integer NOT NULL,
	`uses` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `invitations_hash_unique` ON `invitations` (`hash`);
CREATE INDEX `invitations_workspace` ON `invitations` (`workspace_id`);

CREATE TABLE `recovery_keys` (
	`hash` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`claim_id` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE INDEX `recovery_keys_user` ON `recovery_keys` (`user_id`);

CREATE TABLE `workspace_bans` (
	`workspace_id` text NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`workspace_id`, `user_id`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);

name: 0007_cultured_toad_men
statements:
CREATE TABLE `telegram_outbox` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`message_id` text NOT NULL,
	`attempts` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`due_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`message_id`) REFERENCES `messages`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);
CREATE INDEX `telegram_outbox_due` ON `telegram_outbox` (`status`,`due_at`);

CREATE TABLE `telegram_preferences` (
	`user_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`enabled` integer DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	`preview` integer DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	`messaging_allowed` integer DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	`muted_channel_ids` text DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);

CREATE TABLE `thread_followers` (
	`thread_id` text NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`thread_id`, `user_id`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`thread_id`) REFERENCES `threads`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `auth_telegram_identity` ON `auth_account` (`provider_id`,`account_id`) WHERE "auth_account"."provider_id" = 'telegram';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `auth_telegram_user` ON `auth_account` (`user_id`) WHERE "auth_account"."provider_id" = 'telegram';

name: 0008_roles_permissions
statements:
CREATE TABLE `audit_events` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`workspace_id` text NOT NULL,
	`actor_id` text NOT NULL,
	`action` text NOT NULL,
	`target_id` text NOT NULL,
	`detail` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);
CREATE INDEX `audit_workspace_time` ON `audit_events` (`workspace_id`,`created_at`);

CREATE TABLE `channel_overrides` (
	`channel_id` text NOT NULL,
	`subject_type` text NOT NULL,
	`subject_id` text NOT NULL,
	`permission` text NOT NULL,
	`effect` text NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`channel_id`, `subject_type`, `subject_id`, `permission`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`channel_id`) REFERENCES `channels`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);

CREATE TABLE `member_roles` (
	`workspace_id` text NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`role_id` text NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`workspace_id`, `user_id`, `role_id`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`,`role_id`) REFERENCES `roles`(`workspace_id`,`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`,`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `memberships`(`user_id`,`workspace_id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);

CREATE TABLE `roles` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`workspace_id` text NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`color` text DEFAULT '#949ba4' NOT NULL,
	`position` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `roles_workspace_id` ON `roles` (`workspace_id`,`id`);
CREATE INDEX `roles_workspace_position` ON `roles` (`workspace_id`,`position`);
INSERT INTO roles (id, workspace_id, name, color, position) SELECT 'everyone:' || id, id, '@everyone', '#949ba4', 0 FROM workspaces;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission) SELECT id, 'channels.view' FROM roles WHERE id = 'everyone:' || workspace_id;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission) SELECT id, 'messages.read' FROM roles WHERE id = 'everyone:' || workspace_id;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission) SELECT id, 'messages.send' FROM roles WHERE id = 'everyone:' || workspace_id;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission) SELECT id, 'reactions.add' FROM roles WHERE id = 'everyone:' || workspace_id;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission) SELECT id, 'threads.create' FROM roles WHERE id = 'everyone:' || workspace_id;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission) SELECT id, 'attachments.upload' FROM roles WHERE id = 'everyone:' || workspace_id;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission) SELECT id, 'voice.connect' FROM roles WHERE id = 'everyone:' || workspace_id;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission) SELECT id, 'voice.speak' FROM roles WHERE id = 'everyone:' || workspace_id;
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission) SELECT id, 'ai.ask' FROM roles WHERE id = 'everyone:' || workspace_id;
